repo_meta_data.description: Verifies & compiles reduced-motion-safe, on-budget UI animation for AI-generated web apps. Validated specs → deterministic GSAP/WAAPI-CSS; WCAG 2.2.2 + 2.3.3 checks. MIT core + keyless MCP server. Not Motion.dev/Framer Motion, not the Android/iOS MotionSpec classes, not a video generator.
